title: A computational protocol for sample selection in biological-derived infrared spectroscopy datasets using Morais-Lima-Martin \(MLM) algorithm
protocol: Download and extract the “MLM.zip” file to a folder of choice.
Navigate within MATLAB to the folder where the “MLM.zip” file was extracted.
Within MATLAB, right click on the folder “MLM” and select “Add to Path > Selected Folders and Subfolders”.
Go to the folder “MLM > DATASET” within MATLAB and double-click on the file ‘DATASET.mat’ to execute the example dataset.
For running the algorithm with another dataset, navigate within MATLAB to the “work” folder containing the dataset of interest and double-click on it.
Calculate how many samples must be assigned to the training set (70%) and test set (30%).
Divide class 1 into 98 samples for training and 42 samples for testing.
Divide class 2 into 70 samples for training and 30 samples for testing.
Apply the MLM algorithm by typing the commands depicted in Figure 2b in the MATLAB Command Window.
Split samples for class 1 into training and test sets with 98 training samples and 42 test samples.
Split samples for class 2 into training and test sets with 70 training samples and 30 test samples.
Combine the training samples from class 1 and class 2 to form the overall training set.
Combine the test samples from class 1 and class 2 to form the overall test set.
Create a group category representing the training samples from both classes.
Create a group category representing the test samples from both classes.
